synonym_screen.Balama: Physical object retained. Rare țâțână/șarnieră synonyms unselected without separate scope/familiarity review.
synonym_screen.Lemn: Material retained. Copac/arbore is the living plant; cherestea is a processed product. No identity merge or wood-piece plural imported.
synonym_screen.Fermoar: Closure retained. Fermetură is not automatically adopted as a broad unqualified synonym.
synonym_screen.Nasture: Bumb retained only as a historical/regional research lead; no synonym adoption.
synonym_screen.Perdea: Draperie may be opaque/thicker; no synonym adoption or projection retirement.
synonym_screen.Ață: Only sewing-thread sense explored; bare fir/fire can describe other things, no synonym adoption.
synonym_screen.Clanță: Modern door handle explored; bare mâner covers more objects, no synonym adoption.
synonym_screen.Toc de ușă: Construction frame explored; bare toc has other senses, no synonym adoption.

scope_limit: This is an exact inventory/identity screen and bounded authoring scope, not review acceptance, target approval or playable-round proof.
